entities.name: Ismaïl Moalla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ismaïl Moalla is a Tunisian male volleyball player. He is part of the Tunisia men's national volleyball team. He competed with the national team at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London, Great Britain. He played with CS Sfaxien in 2012.
